test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The thief who had been __accused for the bank theft was__ later acquitted because of lack of evidence.

options.text: accusing for the bank theft was
accused in the bank theft was
accused of the bank theft was
accusing of the bank theft was

solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 3"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct phrase to be substituted in the above sentence is "**accused of the bank theft was**".
 
• In the given sentence "**accused**" is the past participle form of the verb.
 
• It requires the preposition "**of**" to indicate the crime or offense the thief is accused of.
 
• Hence, "**accused of the bank theft was**" is the correct phrase to be substituted.

Therefore, the correct answer is "**Option 3**".

**Correct Sentence**: "The thief who had been **accused of the bank theft**__ was later acquitted because of lack of evidence."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"accusing for the bank theft was"** is incorrect because** "accusing"** is the wrong form, and** "for"** is the wrong preposition.
 
• **"accused in the bank theft was"** is incorrect because** "accused in"** is not the correct preposition to use with **"accused."**
 
• **"accusing of the bank theft was"** is incorrect because **"accusing"** is the wrong form of the verb.
